features.feature: Narrow Koala-owned lifecycle artifact policy for command-generated story metadata

features.feature: convergence_check ignores derived build dirs and survives symlink loops without hiding docs/story truth sources
features.source: plan.md#CHK-003 + docs/requirements/decisions/truth-source.md: tasks/gap-analyze.ts + handlers/gap.ts + core/runtime-artifact-registry.ts add anchored derived-dir ignores and symlink-aware traversal; verify-gap-convergence.mjs simulates .build symlink loop expecting JSON containing converged; adversarial intent confirms docs/story drift still detected.

features.feature: session_brief prioritizes blocking scope failures before DONE hints
features.source: plan.md#CHK-004 + docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md: handlers/session.ts computes strongest blocking gate first via core/done-oracle.ts and core/review-scope-binding.ts; userSees asserts Scope gate: blocking and DONE is not recommended while scope is blocking appear before any DONE hint; edge intent preserves existing missing-delivery/summary hints.

features.feature: Plan preserves product source scope enforcement and does not allow arbitrary TEST acknowledgement
features.source: plan.md Scope Principles + CHK-002 + CHK-005 + docs/requirements/decisions/story-lifecycle.md: plan states story fixes self-locks without weakening product source scope enforcement and TEST gains no broad acknowledgement (only exact delivery and summary artifacts); CHK-002 implementation explicitly forbids scope_contract_acknowledge in TEST and unrelated files; CHK-005 mandates the phrase does not weaken product source scope enforcement plus passing koala validate / check / convergence_check transcripts.
